# PresetHub

> PresetHub is a Lightroom preset marketplace and shayari platform. Free and premium Lightroom presets (XMP and DNG) by creators, shayari and text prompts you can copy, share and post, and tools for creators.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://presethub.site/): presets, shayari and today's pick
- [All presets](https://presethub.site/presets/): browse Lightroom presets by category and price
- [Shayari and text prompts](https://presethub.site/shayari/): sad shayari, true lines, love, attitude and captions
- [Hashtags](https://presethub.site/tags/): every tag across presets and shayari
- [Lightroom guide](https://presethub.site/lightroom-guide.html): how to install and use XMP and DNG presets
- [Download guide](https://presethub.site/download-guide.html): how to download and install presets from PresetHub
- [Creator programme](https://presethub.site/creator-program.html): sell presets and shayari on PresetHub
- [Tools](https://presethub.site/tools.html): caption and hashtag generator, text on photo
- [FAQ](https://presethub.site/faq.html): common questions about presets, payments and Pro membership
